text: Feed control lab. Natural language control of a short video recommender on real QA Rec
data on this laptop. A SAS Rec model trained on QA Rec ranks the videos. The language model
only proposes changes. I review them. First, the original study. Condition C takes a free
text category instruction. I name one category by its dataset ID. Apply, the rule parser
reads it, and the fixed policy boosts that category. The ranking changed, and each card
explains the boost. Compare A to E shows all five conditions side by side. Now the language
controls. The display is in English, machine translated from the original Chinese, and
labeled as such. One click shows the original. On the right, this user's top 10 from the
train model. Provider, the OpenAI API. Model, GPT-5, the strongest model in my tests that
needs only an API key. A key pasted here is masked and kept in memory only. Here it comes
from an environment variable. Use this provider. Workflow 1, the reference, a manual category
control, no model. I search the QA Rec categories. Labels can be searched in English. I pick
dance. Show more. Strong. Preview, a preview never changes the feed. 10 videos would enter
the top 10. Before. And after. Apply changes exactly the reviewed set. Applied, each card
names the control that moved it. Undo restores the previous feed exactly. Workflow 2, a request
in my own words, map to existing categories and tags. I just ate and do not want to be
tempted by food. No category name is used. Interpret and preview. The model reads the
request and the list of existing labels. It sees no video text. Next, the server checks
that every label exists and that the quoted words are in the request. The answer is back.
Proposal, show less category snack, show less category food tutorial, show less topic tag
Q-Shoe Kitchen, show less topic tag homemade food. One model call, 14 seconds of model
time, about 4 cents. The review shows the model's reason, the server's checks, and
the effect on the feed. Apply. Undo. A second request in another domain. My cat is at the
vet and I cannot bear to see animals. No category name is used. Interpret and preview.
The model reads the request and the list of existing labels. It sees no video text.
Next, the server checks that every label exists and that the quoted words are in the request.
The answer is back. Proposal, hide category pets, hide category pet daily record, hide
category pet dog, hide category pet cat, and 21 more. One model call, 15 seconds of
model time, about 4 cents. The review shows the model's reason, the server's checks, and
the effect on the feed. Apply. Undo. Workflow 3, a new category that QI Rec does not have.
I describe it. Plain English, no existing label. Step 1, propose a definition. The model
reads the description and this user's top 40 videos. It drafts a label and a definition
and cites example videos with exact quotations. The answer is back. A label, a definition
with conditions, and three cited examples, each quotation checked. I review it and rename
the label. When applied, show more. Approve and classify. Each video in scope is classified
under the definition, 10 per call, 4 calls in parallel. Every match must quote the video's
own text. A separate call checks each quotation without seeing the verdict. Only matches that
pass both checks are selected. Still waiting for the model, 21 so far. The answer is back.
One row per video, verdict, quotation, independent check, one of 40 selected, five model calls,
63 seconds of model time, about 6 cents. The feed stays visible on the right during
review. Apply. The new category is now a label of its own. Workflow 4, add a video that is
not in QA Rec, a title, and a description. The model sees only these words, classify
and preview. The model assigns existing categories and tags and judges the new category with
a quotation. Still waiting for the model, 8 so far. It got existing categories and tags
and a checked verdict for my new category. Apply. It starts at a cold start score since
the model has no history for it. Undo and undo again. Last control, auto apply. With
it on, a preview is applied as soon as it arrives. Preview and it is already applied.
I turn it off and undo. The results page reads the measured result files. The first table
is the nonliteral requests. Exact means the right action, every required label, and nothing
outside the reviewed acceptable set. Claude Sonnet 5.517 of 20, GPT 5.17 of 20, GPT 5 Mini
16 of 20. Next, cases where the model should not change the feed. Correct abstentions, Claude
Sonnet 5.512 of 14, GPT 5.10 of 14, GPT 5 Mini 7 of 14. For new categories, member F1 on
the shared pool of 150 QA Rec items, Claude Sonnet 5.50.87, GPT 5.0.92, GPT 5 Mini 0.94.
Downstream, on the trained ranker, the controls raise the share of target videos in the top
10 from almost zero toward the level of the reviewed control. The table and the non-inferiority
test below give the exact numbers, including where the relative 10% margin is not met.
The last table lists latency, cost, and every failure of every model. Below, the old
parser bank is reused and labeled as reuse. Llama again scores 79, short of the 85% target.
The test set was drafted by an AI and reviewed row by row by me. Claude is both the drafter's
family and a measured model. Code, tests, and results are in the repository. Thank you.
